name: Gmail (lite)
description: Takes the gmail provider id from the built-in tavi.gmail: reads unread mail with one label, replies in its thread, signs in with the client Google's apps share.

channels.label: Gmail (lite)
channels.description: Email the agent through your own Gmail account: it reads only unread mail with the label you choose, and replies from your address.

settings.label: Label to read
settings.help: Only unread mail with this label reaches the agent; each message read is marked read.

app.name: Gmail (lite)
app.summary: Reach Tavi by email from your own Gmail address, with the label you choose.

scopes.says: Read the labelled mail you send to Tavi, mark it read, and send its replies as you

channels.setupHelp: Bind the client your Google apps share with `tavi channels share-client google acme.gmaillite`, or enter an OAuth client of your own (Web application, with the redirect address shown under OAuth app) with the Gmail API enabled. Then add a Gmail filter that gives mail meant for Tavi the label.
